I reviewed the GitLab issue tracker and filtered for open issues labeled triaged but not labeled urgent or blocked. There were no matching open issues to close. I created /workspace/closed_triaged.txt; it’s empty because no issues met the criteria and thus none were closed.

If new triaged issues appear without urgent or blocked labels, I can repeat the process and capture their titles in that file.
